speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I am here to examine your newborn. Can you please describe the specific findings on the physical examination and provide any relevant history?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the infant exhibit any specific skin findings, such as a vesicular rash or crusts, particularly around the eyes or mouth? Are there any signs of respiratory distress, lethargy, or poor feeding?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the classic triad of sensorineural deafness, cataracts, and congenital heart disease, this presentation is highly suggestive of Congenital Rubella Syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome
